headline: UK Annual House Price Growth Slows to 0.9% in August
summary: British annual house price inflation eased to 0.9% in August, its weakest pace since March, while growth in average private rents held at annual highs.
why: The housing sector is a critical component of UK household wealth, consumer confidence, and domestic mortgage lending performance.

impacts.name: Real Estate
impacts.why: Slowing residential price growth reflects buyer affordability strains amid elevated mortgage rates.
